evcrm-in.name: EvCRM — Indian Vehicle Market & Marketplace
evcrm-in.description: Live vehicle marketplace, verified market-wide EV data (CTE), buyer's guides, and dealer listings for India. Read-only, no auth required.

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description: Search live vehicle inventory across verified EvCRM dealers.

tools.name: get_vehicle_details
tools.description: Full specs for one EvCRM listing by ID.

tools.name: search_market
tools.description: Search CTE's verified Indian automobile market database — specs, pricing, and transparency scores cross-checked across multiple sources, covering the whole market.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Head-to-head comparison of two or more vehicle models from CTE's verified market database.

tools.name: get_blog_article
tools.description: Full text of one buyer's guide, plus current matching inventory.

tools.name: get_knowledge_article
tools.description: Full text of one Learn article.

tools.name: find_dealers
tools.description: Find verified vehicle dealers with their own storefront pages, plus real nearby dealerships (Google Places) when no partner covers that city.

tools.name: calculate_emi
tools.description: Loan EMI, total interest and total payable for a vehicle loan. Deterministic amortisation, no AI.

tools.name: vehicle_budget_from_emi
tools.description: Loan amount and vehicle budget a given monthly EMI supports. Deterministic, no AI.

tools.name: web_search_intelligence
tools.description: Universal Search Intelligence for the Indian Automotive Industry. Queries real-time prices, specs, trends, and market intelligence for EVs and traditional vehicles across the internet.
